description: This file implements the Bluetooth HCI driver for Zephyr OS, handling communication between the controller and host, including thread management, packet processing, and flow control.

methods.name: hci_recv_fifo_reset
methods.description: Resets the receive FIFO queue and cancels any waiting threads.

methods.name: process_prio_evt
methods.description: Processes priority events, such as connection disconnections, and generates appropriate HCI events.

methods.name: prio_recv_thread
methods.description: Thread function that handles incoming data from the controller, including ISO and connection events, and hands them over to the host.

methods.name: encode_node
methods.description: Encodes a received node into an HCI event or ACL data buffer based on its class.

methods.name: process_node
methods.description: Processes a node received from the radio, handling flow control and encoding.

methods.name: process_hbuf
methods.description: Handles host buffer flow control, dequeuing and encoding buffers for transmission.

methods.name: recv_thread
methods.description: Main thread that blocks on FIFO to process incoming radio nodes and send them to the host.

methods.name: cmd_handle
methods.description: Handles HCI command packets and enqueues responses.

methods.name: hci_driver_send
methods.description: Sends HCI packets to the controller, dispatching based on packet type.

methods.name: hci_driver_open
methods.description: Initializes the HCI driver, including threads, flow control, and hardware.

methods.name: hci_driver_close
methods.description: Deinitializes the HCI driver, stopping threads and resetting hardware.

methods.name: hci_driver_init
methods.description: Registers the HCI driver during system initialization.
